6th Grade · Theme 2 · Classroom Life

Vocabulary Quiz

Test 1 / 3
Cevaplanan: 0 / 50

Doğru şıkkı işaretle. Cevabını değiştirebilirsin. Bitirince altta TESTİ BİTİR düğmesine bas. Menü ile başka bir teste geçebilirsin.

1Vocabulary Test 1 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Ece reads for ten minutes before bed every day. She does this regularly without a reminder. Reading before bed is her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) habit

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ece reads for ten minutes before bed every day. She does this regularly without a reminder.” Bu tarif “habit” kelimesine uyar; habit = alışkanlık. Diğer şıklar: sort (tür, çeşit), diary (günlük), level (seviye).

2

Selin wants facts about bees for a project. She checks books and reliable websites and writes notes. This careful study is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) research

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Selin wants facts about bees for a project. She checks books and reliable websites and writes notes.” Bu tarif “research” kelimesine uyar; research = araştırma. Diğer şıklar: activity (etkinlik), method (yöntem), task (görev).

3

Duru uses a toothbrush and toothpaste every morning. She cleans her teeth after breakfast. She remembers to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) brush teeth

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Duru uses a toothbrush and toothpaste every morning. She cleans her teeth after breakfast.” Bu tarif “brush teeth” kelimesine uyar; brush teeth = diş fırçalamak. Diğer şıklar: read silently (sessiz okumak), count (saymak), share (paylaşmak).

4

Elif feels tired after a long study session. She stops working and relaxes for a short time. She decides to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) have a rest

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Elif feels tired after a long study session. She stops working and relaxes for a short time.” Bu tarif “have a rest” kelimesine uyar; have a rest = dinlenmek. Diğer şıklar: work in groups (grupla çalışmak), exercise (alıştırma yapmak), remember (hatırlamak).

5

Nehir cannot find her notebook. She looks in her bag, under her desk and on the shelf. She needs to ______ for it.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) search

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir cannot find her notebook. She looks in her bag, under her desk and on the shelf.” Bu tarif “search” kelimesine uyar; search = aramak. Diğer şıklar: repeat (tekrar etmek), recycle (geri dönüştürmek), practise (alıştırma yapmak).

6

Sena turns off the television before studying. She gives all her attention to one task. She wants to ______ on her homework.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) focus

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena turns off the television before studying. She gives all her attention to one task.” Bu tarif “focus” kelimesine uyar; focus = odaklanmak. Diğer şıklar: read aloud (sesli okumak), work in pairs (ikili çalışmak), revise (yeniden incelemek).

7

İpek checks her notes after every lesson. She reads the main points again to remember them. She likes to ______ her notes.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) review

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek checks her notes after every lesson. She reads the main points again to remember them.” Bu tarif “review” kelimesine uyar; review = gözden geçirmek. Diğer şıklar: have a rest (dinlenmek), read silently (sessiz okumak), brush teeth (diş fırçalamak).

8

Eylül collects used paper in a special box. A factory uses it to make new paper products. Her class helps to ______ paper.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) recycle

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül collects used paper in a special box. A factory uses it to make new paper products.” Bu tarif “recycle” kelimesine uyar; recycle = geri dönüştürmek. Diğer şıklar: read aloud (sesli okumak), share (paylaşmak), count (saymak).

9

Cemre hears a new word from her teacher. She says exactly the same word again. The teacher asks her to ______ it.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) repeat

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre hears a new word from her teacher. She says exactly the same word again.” Bu tarif “repeat” kelimesine uyar; repeat = tekrar etmek. Diğer şıklar: review (gözden geçirmek), focus (odaklanmak), exercise (alıştırma yapmak).

10

Melis has a test tomorrow. She studies the topics again to refresh her memory. She needs to ______ before the test.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) revise

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Melis has a test tomorrow. She studies the topics again to refresh her memory.” Bu tarif “revise” kelimesine uyar; revise = yeniden incelemek. Diğer şıklar: work in groups (grupla çalışmak), work in pairs (ikili çalışmak), search (aramak).

11

Sıla learns a new word on Monday. On Friday, she can still give its meaning without looking it up. She can ______ the word.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) remember

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sıla learns a new word on Monday. On Friday, she can still give its meaning without looking it up.” Bu tarif “remember” kelimesine uyar; remember = hatırlamak. Diğer şıklar: count (saymak), read aloud (sesli okumak), have a rest (dinlenmek).

12

Defne wants to improve her English pronunciation. She says difficult words again every day. She needs to ______ regularly.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) practise

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Defne wants to improve her English pronunciation. She says difficult words again every day.” Bu tarif “practise” kelimesine uyar; practise = alıştırma yapmak. Diğer şıklar: search (aramak), focus (odaklanmak), share (paylaşmak).

13

Buse does an activity with only one partner. The two students ask and answer questions together. They ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) work in pairs

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Buse does an activity with only one partner. The two students ask and answer questions together.” Bu tarif “work in pairs” kelimesine uyar; work in pairs = ikili çalışmak. Diğer şıklar: recycle (geri dönüştürmek), remember (hatırlamak), brush teeth (diş fırçalamak).

14

İdil does a project with four other students. All five students share ideas and tasks. They ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) work in groups

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İdil does a project with four other students. All five students share ideas and tasks.” Bu tarif “work in groups” kelimesine uyar; work in groups = grupla çalışmak. Diğer şıklar: review (gözden geçirmek), revise (yeniden incelemek), exercise (alıştırma yapmak).

15

Zeynep has coloured pencils and her friend has none. She lets her friend use them too. She agrees to ______ her pencils.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) share

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Zeynep has coloured pencils and her friend has none. She lets her friend use them too.” Bu tarif “share” kelimesine uyar; share = paylaşmak. Diğer şıklar: practise (alıştırma yapmak), read silently (sessiz okumak), repeat (tekrar etmek).

16

Mina writes about her feelings and daily events. She keeps these dated personal notes in a small book. It is her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) diary

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mina writes about her feelings and daily events. She keeps these dated personal notes in a small book.” Bu tarif “diary” kelimesine uyar; diary = günlük. Diğer şıklar: learning (öğrenme), teaching (öğretme), method (yöntem).

17

Pelin starts an English course for beginners. After more study, she moves to a more advanced class. Her language ______ improves.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) level

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Pelin starts an English course for beginners. After more study, she moves to a more advanced class.” Bu tarif “level” kelimesine uyar; level = seviye. Diğer şıklar: habit (alışkanlık), research (araştırma), activity (etkinlik).

18

Derya enjoys one kind of reading activity more than others. She especially likes stories about animals. That is her favourite ______ of activity.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) sort

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Derya enjoys one kind of reading activity more than others. She especially likes stories about animals.” Bu tarif “sort” kelimesine uyar; sort = tür, çeşit. Diğer şıklar: task (görev), diary (günlük), method (yöntem).

19

Sena gains new knowledge and skills in class. She understands more each time she studies. This process is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) learning

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena gains new knowledge and skills in class. She understands more each time she studies.” Bu tarif “learning” kelimesine uyar; learning = öğrenme. Diğer şıklar: habit (alışkanlık), activity (etkinlik), research (araştırma).

20

Eda helps younger children understand English words. She explains meanings and shows them examples. Her work involves ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) teaching

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eda helps younger children understand English words. She explains meanings and shows them examples.” Bu tarif “teaching” kelimesine uyar; teaching = öğretme. Diğer şıklar: level (seviye), sort (tür, çeşit), diary (günlük).

21

Cem uses word cards to study vocabulary. This is his chosen way of learning new words. It is his study ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) method

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cem uses word cards to study vocabulary. This is his chosen way of learning new words.” Bu tarif “method” kelimesine uyar; method = yöntem. Diğer şıklar: learning (öğrenme), research (araştırma), habit (alışkanlık).

22

Eren's teacher asks him to make a poster for Friday. This is a piece of work he needs to complete. It is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) task

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eren's teacher asks him to make a poster for Friday. This is a piece of work he needs to complete.” Bu tarif “task” kelimesine uyar; task = görev. Diğer şıklar: teaching (öğretme), level (seviye), sort (tür, çeşit).

23

Baran's class plays a word game during the lesson. Everyone joins this planned classroom event. It is a learning ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) activity

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran's class plays a word game during the lesson. Everyone joins this planned classroom event.” Bu tarif “activity” kelimesine uyar; activity = etkinlik. Diğer şıklar: learning (öğrenme), diary (günlük), method (yöntem).

24

Tolga wants to keep his body fit. He walks quickly and does simple movements every morning. He likes to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) exercise

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga wants to keep his body fit. He walks quickly and does simple movements every morning.” Bu tarif “exercise” kelimesine uyar; exercise = alıştırma yapmak. Diğer şıklar: work in pairs (ikili çalışmak), focus (odaklanmak), brush teeth (diş fırçalamak).

25

Ozan reads a story without making any sound. His lips stay still, and only he follows the words. He likes to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) read silently

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan reads a story without making any sound. His lips stay still, and only he follows the words.” Bu tarif “read silently” kelimesine uyar; read silently = sessiz okumak. Diğer şıklar: read aloud (sesli okumak), remember (hatırlamak), revise (yeniden incelemek).

3Vocabulary Quiz 50 · Choose the correct Turkish meaning of each word. (Her kelimenin doğru Türkçe anlamını seçiniz.)

1

habit

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) alışkanlık

“habit” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “alışkanlık” olur. Bu ifade “Alışkanlıklar ve rutinler” grubundandır. Örnek: Reading every night is a good habit.

2

research

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) araştırma

“research” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “araştırma” olur. Bu ifade “Öğrenme eylemleri” grubundandır. Örnek: We did research about volcanoes.

3

brush teeth

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) diş fırçalamak

“brush teeth” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “diş fırçalamak” olur. Bu ifade “Alışkanlıklar ve rutinler” grubundandır. Örnek: I brush my teeth twice a day.

4

have a rest

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) dinlenmek

“have a rest” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “dinlenmek” olur. Bu ifade “Alışkanlıklar ve rutinler” grubundandır. Örnek: I have a rest after school.

5

search

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) aramak

“search” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “aramak” olur. Bu ifade “Öğrenme eylemleri” grubundandır. Örnek: I search for information online.

6

focus

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) odaklanmak

“focus” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “odaklanmak” olur. Bu ifade “Öğrenme eylemleri” grubundandır. Örnek: Turn off your phone and focus on your homework.

7

review

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) gözden geçirmek

“review” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “gözden geçirmek” olur. Bu ifade “Öğrenme eylemleri” grubundandır. Örnek: I review my notes before a test.
